En medio de las repercusiones políticas, el ministro de Transportes español, Óscar Puente, anunció su renuncia durante una comparecencia en el Congreso. Además, el Gobierno aprobó un paquete de 30 millones de euros en ayudas para las víctimas y sus familiares. | LA NACION

item.title: Ukraine and Russia both hit by cyberattacks on emergency apps
item.description: Authorities in both Ukraine and Russia said that their emergency alert mobile applications were targeted by cyberattacks late Sunday. Residents in Ukraine received messages that there was a high nuclear radiation danger in the capital Kyiv, while Russian officials said hackers had sent fake emergency alerts after gaining access to the mobile app for Russia’s Emergency Ministry.
